main_text.head: وهو اول بطويبك بالاسكندرية
main_text.p: عمل الاساقفة[?] qvæ ad verbum & fidelissimè sic reddenda sunt: Et est primus Patriarcha, qvi in Alexandria fecit Episcopos. Ea tamen sic infidelissimè reddit Seldenus; & primus fuit hic Patriarcha Alexandrinus, qvi Episcopos fecit. Profecto Demetrius non fuit primus Patriarcha Alexandriius, qvi Episcopos fecit; sed primus, qvi fecit Episcopos in urbe Alexandrina, qvemadmodum pluribus adductis testimoniis ex antiqvissimis illius Ecclesiæ monumentis, & Scriptoribus in responsione ad ipsum Seldenum ostendimus; & hoc qvidem mirum in modum consonat iis, qvæ in Alexandrino Chronico de Episcoporum antiqvitate leguntur in Juliano Demetrii prædecessore; sed eo tempore nulli poterant[?] Alexandriæ commorari; at nos Episcoporum originem & successiones à D. Marco, & Anania arcessimus; sed nec nomine Ægypti universa Patriarchalis Dioe-

page.notes: The Arabic heading and the Arabic opening word of the paragraph are copied from the scan and may contain small errors in diacritics or letter forms; the paragraph's first Arabic word is uncertain. "poterant" is partly obscured by a blot. The line "Alexandriius" and "arcessimus" are printed as shown. The paragraph continues on the next page ("Dioe-" is a hyphenated line end). No catchword is visible.
